title: Grilled Steak with Date Chutney
description: A savory and sweet combination of grilled steak served with a date-based chutney, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Season the steak with salt and pepper.
Grill the steak for 4-5 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, blend the dates in a food processor until smooth.
Add the earthy nightshade to the food processor and blend until well combined.
Transfer the date mixture to a bowl.
Once the steak is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Serve the sliced steak with the date chutney spooned over the top.
